> 第25章 仙凡之别（第1页）
正当众人沉浸在重逢的喜悦中时，一阵急促的脚步声由远及近。
身着明黄太子袍的少年匆匆赶来，当他看到那个熟悉的小身影时，眼中瞬间迸发出惊喜的光芒。
“太子哥哥！”林枝意像只欢快的小鸟般扑进少年怀中，“意意好想你！”
林修远紧紧抱着妹妹，这个一向稳重的太子此刻也难掩激动
“才一月未见，皇兄也觉得像是过了好久好久。”
虽然分别仅一月，但修仙无岁月，再加上林枝意经历洗髓丹的改造和刻苦修炼，气质已然有了微妙的变化，让亲人感觉分别之久远超实际。
林枝意从兄长怀中抬起头，小脸上写满了骄傲
“父皇母后皇兄，意意有出息的，师父我说的对不对？”
所有人的目光都聚焦在凤临渊身上。
这位仙尊微微颔首，语气平淡却带着不容置疑的权威
“嗯，是，意意是五行之外的变异雷灵根。”
“！！！”帝后和太子同时倒吸一口凉气。
这在修仙界可是千年难遇的绝世资质！
凤临渊的目光扫过四个小团子，继续道
“钱多多单金灵根，柳轻舞，五行之外单风灵根，云逸，五行之外冰灵根外加天生剑体，李寒风，五行之外冰灵根。”
他顿了顿，说出了一句让在场所有人都震惊的话“修仙界天赋最好的几个，几乎都在这了。”
林宸渊的声音有些发颤“然后意意还把他们都打败了？”
“是的。”凤临渊的肯定如同惊雷，在每个人心中炸响。
方才他们只知道女儿拿了比试第一名，却不知道她是在与如此多的天才竞争中脱颖而出！
林修远蹲下身，仔细端详着妹妹“枝意，这一个月你吃了多少苦？”
小公主歪着头想了想，掰着手指头数
“意意每天要挥剑一千下，还要练习五百次基础功，还要学习控制雷灵力，还要识字读书”
她每说一项，亲人们的心就揪紧一分。
“不过意意很厉害的！”林枝意突然想起什么，小脸绽放出灿烂的笑容，
“师虎说意意只用了三个时辰就引气入体了！是玄天剑派有史以来最快的！”
看着女儿天真烂漫的模样，苏云卿的眼泪又止不住地流下来。
凤临渊适时提醒“不过凡间不可动用灵力，扰乱人间因果。”
林枝意乖巧点头“意意知道！师虎说在人间用灵力会沾因果，对修行不好，所以不能给你们展示啦。”
“但是，”凤临渊话锋一转，指向那些堆积如山的礼物，
“凡人使用丹药、符箓、法器、法衣，这些可以的，不算扰乱因果。”
作为一国之君，他立刻明白了这些修仙之物的价值——
“仙尊厚赐，朕感激不尽。”林宸渊郑重行礼。
凤临渊淡淡摆手“不必多礼，这些都是孩子们的心意。”
“陛下，这些丹药在修仙界虽然不算顶级，但在人间界可是万金难求呢！特别是那瓶延寿丹，至少能延寿三十年！”
“法衣可避水火，符箓可挡灾厄，陛下和娘娘务必随身携带。”
听着孩子们七嘴八舌的介绍，林宸渊和苏云卿既感动又震惊。
这些在修仙界看似平常的物品，在人间可谓是千金难求。
“父皇母后，”林枝意拉着父母的手，大眼睛闪闪发光，
“以后再也没有人敢欺负你们了！要是有人来找麻烦，就让意意和师父教训他们！”
童言稚语中透露出的维护之意，让在场的大人们都为之动容。
或许，收下这个小徒弟，不仅改变了她的命运，也在不经意间，影响了这个凡人国度的未来。

> Chapter 25 The Difference Between Immortals and Mortals (Page 1)
Just as everyone was immersed in the joy of reunion, there was a rush of footsteps approaching from far away.
The young man wearing a bright yellow prince's robe hurried over. When he saw the familiar little figure, his eyes instantly burst with surprise.
"Brother Prince!" Lin Zhiyi flew into the boy's arms like a cheerful bird, "I miss you so much!"
Lin Xiuyuan hugged his sister tightly. The usually steady prince could not hide his excitement at this moment.
"It's only been a month since I last saw you. Brother Huang, it feels like a long time has passed."
Although they were separated for only one month, they had not spent many years practicing immortality. In addition, Lin Zhiyi had undergone transformation and hard training with the Marrow Cleansing Pill, and his temperament had already undergone subtle changes, which made the relatives feel that the separation was far longer than reality.
Lin Zhiyi raised his head from his brother's arms, with pride written all over his face.
"My father, the emperor, my mother, my queen, and my brother are all promising. Master, am I right?"
Everyone's eyes were focused on Feng Linyuan.
The Immortal Lord nodded slightly, his tone calm but with unquestionable authority.
"Well, yes, Yiyi is a mutated thunder spirit root outside the Five Elements."
"!!!" The emperor and the prince gasped at the same time.
This is a peerless qualification that is rare to see in the world of immortality in a thousand years!
Feng Linyuan glanced at the four little dumplings and continued:
"Qian Duoduo has a single golden spiritual root, Liu Qingwu, a single wind spiritual root beyond the five elements, Yun Yi, an ice spiritual root beyond the five elements plus a natural sword body, Li Hanfeng, and an ice spiritual root beyond the five elements."
He paused and said something that shocked everyone present, "Almost all the most talented people in the world of immortality are here."
Lin Chenyuan's voice was trembling, "And then Yiyi defeated them all?"
"Yes." Feng Linyuan's affirmation was like thunder, exploding in everyone's heart.
Just now, they only knew that their daughter won the first place in the competition, but they didn't know that she stood out among so many talented people!
Lin Xiuyuan squatted down and looked at his sister carefully, "Zhiyi, how much hardship have you suffered this month?"
The little princess tilted her head and thought for a while, counting on her fingers.
"Yi Yi needs to swing his sword a thousand times every day, practice basic skills five hundred times, learn to control the power of thunder, and learn to read and write."
Every time she said something, the hearts of her relatives tightened.
"But the meaning is very powerful!" Lin Zhiyi suddenly remembered something, and a bright smile broke out on his face,
"Shi Hu said that it only took three hours for his mind to draw Qi into his body! It is the fastest in the history of Xuantian Sword Sect!"
Seeing her daughter's innocent appearance, Su Yunqing's tears couldn't stop flowing down.
Feng Linyuan reminded him at the right time, "However, spiritual power cannot be used in the mortal world to disturb the cause and effect in the human world."
Lin Zhiyi nodded obediently, "I know! Shi Hu said that using spiritual power in the human world will cause karma, which is not good for practice, so I can't show it to you."
"But," Feng Linyuan changed the subject and pointed at the mountains of gifts.
"It's okay for mortals to use elixirs, talismans, magic weapons, and robes, but they don't count as disturbing the cause and effect."
As the king of a country, he immediately understood the value of these immortal things——
"I am deeply grateful for the generous gift from the Immortal Lord." Lin Chenyuan saluted solemnly.
Feng Linyuan waved his hand calmly, "No need to be polite, these are the children's wishes."
"Your Majesty, although these pills are not top-notch in the world of immortality, they are hard to find in the human world! Especially the bottle of life-extending pill, which can extend your life for at least thirty years!"
"The robes can protect you from water and fire, and the talismans can ward off disasters. Your Majesty and your empress must carry them with you."
Listening to the children's enthusiastic introductions, Lin Chenyuan and Su Yunqing were both moved and shocked.
These seemingly ordinary items in the world of immortality are hard to find in the human world.
"Father, Emperor and Mother," Lin Zhiyi held her parents' hands, her big eyes sparkling,
"No one will dare to bully you again! If someone comes to cause trouble, let Yiyi and Master teach them a lesson!"
The meaning of protection revealed in the children's childish words moved the adults present.
Perhaps, accepting this little apprentice not only changed her destiny, but also inadvertently affected the future of this mortal country.
